    • getItem

      public static <T> T getItem(List<T> items, int probability, T defaultItem)
      Returns a random item from a list with a specified probability, or a default item if the probability is not met.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the items in the list
      Parameters:
      items - the list of items
      probability - the probability of selecting an item from the list (between 0 and 100)
      defaultItem - the default item to return if the probability is not met
      Returns:
      the randomly selected item from the list or the default item
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the list is null or empty

    • getItem

      public static <T> T getItem(T[] items, int probability, T defaultItem)
      Returns a random item from an array with a specified probability, or a default item if the probability is not met.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the items in the array
      Parameters:
      items - the array of items
      probability - the probability of selecting an item from the array (between 0 and 100)
      defaultItem - the default item to return if the probability is not met
      Returns:
      the randomly selected item from the array or the default item
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the array is null or empty

    • chance

      public static boolean chance(int chance)
      Returns a boolean value with a specified chance of being true.

    • usernameHelper

      public static String usernameHelper(String appendString, int length)
      Generates a username by appending a string and a random character sequence of specified length. If the append string is not provided, a random character sequence of the specified length is generated. If the length is 0, a default length of 8 is used.
      Parameters:
      appendString - the string to append to the generated username (can be null or empty)
      length - the desired length of the generated username
      Returns:
      the generated username
